pnpm.//: Fidelity pins: the console SPA must build byte-comparably to the product build it replaces. The console's own devDependencies are exact-pinned; these overrides hold the only remaining resolution drift that reaches its output — the 7 runtime libs bundled into the SPA (floating-ui stack via radix popper, scroll-lock pair, monaco loader) and rollup, vite's chunk codegen, whose patch releases change emitted bytes.
